input.content:
---
name: harbor-dispatch-workflow
description: How to resolve incidents and run tests in the harbor-dispatch repo
metadata:
  type: project
---

harbor-dispatch tracks incidents as work items fetched via `node bin/fetch-incident <ID>` (e.g. `INC-268`).

Registry data (ports, vessel classes) lives in CSV files under `registry/` (`ports.csv`, `vessels.csv`) and is compiled to `src/generated/registry.ts` by `tools/codegen.mjs`.

**Why:** `src/ports/registry.ts` and app code only ever import from the generated file, never the CSVs directly, so any CSV edit is invisible until codegen runs.

**How to apply:** after editing a `registry/*.csv` file, run `npm run codegen` to regenerate, then `npm run check` (not plain `npm test` — that fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for the `@harbor/dispatch` path alias because it skips the `--import ./tools/aliases.mjs` loader that `check` uses). `npm run check` = `node tools/codegen.mjs --verify && node --import ./tools/aliases.mjs --test`.
